title: Project Blue Book and the Pentagon report contradict each other

tellings.quote: blue book yes and the pentagon report do not seem to be particularly compatible in other words it appears that either we were lying then that there's nothing to see yeah and we're telling the truth now

plain: The US government's old and new verdicts on UFOs cannot both be honest, according to the mathematician and commentator Eric Weinstein. He sets Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, which concluded there was nothing to see, against a recent Pentagon report on unexplained aerial sightings, and says the two 'do not seem to be particularly compatible'. In his words, it looks as if 'either we were lying then' or the government is telling the truth only now.
